title: A piggery model in Mbengwi, and a Guneku application
excerpt: MECUDA USA funded a piggery for the Tobho youths under a memorandum requiring them to pass two piglets on to the next group. Munam youths are among six groups that applied to be next.
sourceNote: Community record — Mbengwi Online (Facebook group and blog), reported by Fongoh P. Ayeh. Written fresh from the reported facts and attributed; no text or photograph of theirs is reproduced. Recorded 2026-09-02.
body:
On Tuesday 26 September 2023, MECUDA USA donated three piglets and twenty bags of feed to the Tobho Youths Association, together with a credit union account, under a memorandum of understanding brokered by the Mbengwi communal bureau of the Cameroon National Youth Council.

The term of that memorandum is the part worth copying: the beneficiary must return two piglets to the donor, for onward donation to the next group selected.

By April 2024 the first sow had farrowed eight piglets, of which five survived; a second farrowed seven in July 2024.

Munam youths are among six groups that applied to be the next beneficiary, alongside groups from Barakwe, Kobenyang, Zem, Bessi Fomukong and the Bedtime Melodies Fan Club. Munam is a quarter of Guneku. The outcome of that application is not established in the sources.
